capabilityName: Place Account Hold Request (to confirmation screen)
goal: Signs on to the Meridian Core servicing console with the deployment's operator credentials, looks up a member by member number, opens the Place Account Hold action, fills in share, reason code and notes, and submits to reach the CONFIRM ACCOUNT HOLD review screen (banner: IRREVERSIBLE ACTION). It stops there without applying the hold, and returns the reviewed member, share, reason and notes for human approval. Applying the hold is supervisor-only and is refused by policy in every mode, so a teller deployment escalates to a person at that point. Returns a business outcome if no member matches the number supplied.
reason: Recovering from "supervisor_override_denied" left the run on a screen where step s12 cannot proceed — the interruption most likely discarded work in progress.
guidance: Take the live session back to where this step expects to be — re-entering any form data the interruption discarded — then hand control back. If this screen now interrupts every request, the capability needs a declared step for it rather than a recovery.
stepIntent: Submit the hold request details to reach the Confirm Account Hold review screen.
